description: Local MCP server that lets Claude Code and other MCP clients control OTerminal: stage and commit via the source control panel, open URLs in the built-in browser, focus editors, and run terminal commands. Commits are always authored by the local git user.
untrusted.description: The MCP server exposes editor, source control, and terminal control to local clients. It is disabled in untrusted workspaces.
config.enabled: Run the local MCP server on startup.
config.host: Loopback address to bind to. Keep on 127.0.0.1 unless you understand the implications.
config.port: TCP port for the MCP HTTP+SSE server. 0 = sticky port: pick a free port the first time, then reuse it across restarts.
config.allowedOrigins: Additional HTTP Origin values to accept on the SSE endpoint. Loopback origins are always allowed.
cmd.copyConfig: Copy Claude Code MCP Config to Clipboard
